digest.component_or_area: LLM provider infrastructure (runner, anthropic, bedrock, openai-compatible)
propositions: Provider construction is currently scattered across runner.py via inline if-branches (e.g. startswith('anthropic')), creating no single authoritative location for how providers are built
The retrying httpx.AsyncClient resource must be closed after run() completes or raises, but the current factory hook signature only returns Provider and has no channel for closeable resources
ProviderSession should own client lifecycle by collecting closeables into a private list and closing them all in __exit__, making run() a context manager
The Anthropic builder should move into providers.py but preserve existing behavior: tenacity transport, max_retries=0 guard, loopback-proxy bypass, per-request timeout
Import sites of _build_retrying_anthropic_model in test files must move from rebar.llm.runner to rebar.llm.anthropic_model, with full suite passing unchanged
An unregistered provider name must raise LLMConfigError listing registered providers, not silently fail or raise KeyError
